main_measure.name: OLS slope of next-bar excess return on forecast (forecast > 0 bars)
main_measure.threshold: slope > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 confirms (with check); slope < 0 with t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: forecast-weighted mean next-bar excess return, day-clustered t

decided_by: Confirm: the slope is positive with t >= 2 and the forecast-weighted mean excess return is above 0 with t >= 2.
reading: Every bar with forecast > 0 and a next bar in the same window is used; the coin's mean is the mean next-bar return over all its windows; clustered standard errors use the CR1 sandwich with the G/(G-1)*(N-1)/(N-K) correction; the plan's 'fewer is inconclusive' minimum is reported as 'not observable' as the workflow requires.
